Thane Teen Dies by Suicide After Failing College Admission

A 17-year-old student in Thane died by suicide after failing to secure admission to his preferred college, despite scoring 95.7% in his Class 12 examinations. The student had aimed for admission to IIEST Shibpur. An accidental death report has been registered by the authorities.
